task_text: Get the house ready for bedtime in 15 minutes.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare any light food items in the kitchen that need slicing or pouring.
central_instructions.R2: Transport any light objects from the kitchen to other rooms as needed.
central_instructions.R3: Prepare any light food items in the living room that need slicing or pouring.
central_instructions.R4: Transport any light objects from the living room to other rooms as needed.
central_instructions.R5: Move any heavy objects or furniture in the bedroom to get it ready for bedtime.
central_instructions.R6: Assist in moving heavy objects or furniture in the bathroom or transport items between rooms.

[10-15 min]
- R1 PourObject (Water into Cup) (r1_s3)

[0-5 min]

[15-20 min]
